feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 1 July 2026 4:32am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing.


##Wind)##

W or NW 2 to 4, soon backing S or SW 5 to 7, veering W 5 or 6 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, soon becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair to start with areas of mist and isolated fog patches, then occasional rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

14°C
